text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ardan, I wish you a very happy<n>birthday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, thank you. There's something<n>novel about
hearing you two say that<n>from up close like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is that so? But back at the estate, we<n>would also—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you would wish me a happy<n>birthday—from
across that enormous<n>table, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
True... The table at the estate was<n>pretty massive.
You could hardly see<n>people's faces at the other
end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's why this is so nice, being able<n>to look each
other in the eye while<n>exchanging well wishes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Heh, then I suppose we'll have to<n>say it many
more times throughout<n>the day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, you two. It<n>looks like this will
be a birthday to<n>remember. Hehe.
